outputCoordinateSystem: SVG viewBox user coordinates (top-left origin, Y-down)

horizontalMapping.formula: svgX = contentLeft + (xMeters - minX) * uniformScale; mapX = svgX / viewBoxWidth

verticalMapping.formula: svgY = contentTop + (maxY - yMeters) * uniformScale; mapY = svgY / viewBoxHeight

yAxisOrientation: inverted (SVG Y increases downward; north is smaller Y)
aspectRatioBehavior: uniform isotropic scale (xMidYMid meet, zero non-uniform stretching)
